readingGuide: `affectsCallLint` answers one narrow question: would adopting this delta change a byte CallLint SERVES or a verdict it EMITS? A delta can be normatively important upstream and still be scored `false` here, because CallLint is a stdio server with 13 tools and 19 read-only resources — it is not an HTTP transport, has no auth surface, and runs no long-lived tasks.
